disclaimers.top: ForThePeople.in is NOT an official government website. Data aggregated from official portals (NDSAP), accredited research institutions, and verified public sources. Always verify at the original source.
disclaimers.defence: Data on this page is limited to information publicly disclosed by the Ministry of Defence, Press Information Bureau, and Parliamentary Q&A. ForThePeople.in does not publish, infer, or speculate on classified, operational, or strategic information.
disclaimers.health: Aggregated public-health statistics only. Personal health data and individual hospital outcomes are not published. Consult a registered medical practitioner for health decisions.
disclaimers.elections: Electoral data is for citizen information. ForThePeople.in does not endorse, predict, or campaign for any party or candidate.
disclaimers.justice: Aggregated case statistics from NJDG. Individual case details are not published.
disclaimers.mcc: Model Code of Conduct in effect. ForThePeople.in is non-partisan and complies with ECI guidelines.

health.method: The District Health Score combines 10 governance categories with different weights (total 100%). Scores are computed from live database records. Updated weekly.
health.caveat: This score is indicative and continuously evolving. As more data modules are populated and verified for this district, the score will change. Categories with insufficient data use baseline estimates and are not fully representative. Do not use this score for official comparisons or policy decisions.

generic.title: Data being collected
generic.body: Data for this module is being collected from official government portals for {district}. It will appear here once available.

water.title: Dam & reservoir data being prepared
water.body: Water supply data for {district} is being collected from {portal} and India-WRIS. Dam levels, inflow/outflow, and canal release data will appear here once integration is complete.

crops.title: Crop price data being collected
crops.body: Daily mandi prices from AGMARKNET for {district} are being integrated. Prices for major crops will appear here once data collection begins.

cropsUrban.title: No agricultural markets in this district
cropsUrban.body: {district} is a fully urban district with no registered APMC (Agricultural Produce Market Committee) mandis. Crop price data is not applicable here.

power.title: Power outage tracking being integrated
power.body: Scheduled power outage data from {discom} is being integrated. For current outage information, visit the official portal. {url}

farm.title: Farm advisory data being collected
farm.body: Soil health records and crop advisories from the local KVK (Krishi Vigyan Kendra) and ICAR network are being collected for {district}.

farmUrban.title: Not applicable for urban districts
farmUrban.body: {district} is a fully urban district. Soil health cards, crop advisories, and KVK agricultural data are relevant for rural and semi-rural districts.

gram-panchayat.title: Panchayat data being collected
gram-panchayat.body: Village-level MGNREGA works and fund utilisation data from eGramSwaraj is being collected for {district}.

gram-panchayatUrban.title: Not applicable for urban districts
gram-panchayatUrban.body: {district} is a fully urban district governed by a Municipal Corporation. Gram Panchayat and MGNREGA data applies only to rural areas.

jjm.title: JJM coverage data being collected
jjm.body: Tap water connection data from the Jal Jeevan Mission national dashboard (eJalShakti) is being collected for {district}.

jjmUrban.title: Not applicable for urban districts
jjmUrban.body: Jal Jeevan Mission provides tap water connections to rural households. {district} is urban; its water supply is managed by the municipal water board.

police.title: Crime statistics being collected
police.body: Crime data from NCRB (National Crime Records Bureau) and traffic revenue data for {district} are being collected. NCRB publishes district-level data annually.

transport.title: Transport data being collected
transport.body: Bus routes from {transport} and train schedules from IRCTC for {district} are being integrated.

finance.title: Budget expenditure data being collected
finance.body: Detailed budget allocation and expenditure data from PFMS and the state treasury for {district} is being collected.

housing.title: Housing scheme data being collected
housing.body: PMAY (Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana) housing data from AwaasSoft for {district} is being collected.

schools.title: School data being collected
schools.body: School directory and board exam pass rate data from UDISE+ for {district} is being collected.

courts.title: Court statistics being collected
courts.body: Case pendency and disposal data from the National Judicial Data Grid (NJDG) for {district} is being collected.

rti.title: RTI filing data being collected
rti.body: RTI filing statistics and department-wise response data for {district} are being collected from official RTI portals.

elections.title: Election data being collected
elections.body: Election results and voter data from the Election Commission of India for {district} constituencies are being collected.

health.title: Health facility data being collected
health.body: Hospital directory, bed counts, and doctor-patient ratios from the National Health Mission for {district} are being collected.

industries.title: Industry data being collected
industries.body: Major employers, industrial clusters, and economic data for {district} are being collected from the District Industries Centre.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure project data being collected
infrastructure.body: Ongoing government infrastructure projects (roads, bridges, buildings) from PMGSY and state PWD for {district} are being collected.

news.title: Local news being collected
news.body: News articles from regional media for {district} will appear here once the news feed starts covering this district.

schemes.title: Government scheme data being collected
schemes.body: Central and state government scheme data from MyScheme.gov.in and state portals for {district} is being collected.

famous-personalities.title: Notable personalities being added
famous-personalities.body: Information about notable people from {district} is being compiled from verified sources including Wikipedia (CC-BY-SA licensed).

offices.title: Government office directory being compiled
offices.body: Contact details and addresses for government offices in {district} are being compiled from official state portals.

citizen-corner.title: Citizen tips being prepared
citizen-corner.body: Civic tips and citizen advisories for {district} will appear here once enough district data has been collected.

alerts.title: No active alerts
alerts.body: There are currently no weather warnings, civic alerts, or emergency advisories for {district}. Alerts are collected from IMD, NDMA, and district administration sources.

exams.title: Government exam notifications being collected
exams.body: Exam notifications from UPSC, SSC, state PSC, and recruitment boards relevant to {district} are being collected.

weather.title: Weather data being collected
weather.body: Weather readings from the India Meteorological Department (IMD) and OpenWeatherMap for {district} are being integrated.

population.title: Population data being compiled
population.body: Census 2011 population data and 2026 estimates for {district} are being compiled. Census 2027 is under way; its figures will be added after the official release.
